title: Cortex TaskEnqueueRequest (DRAFT v0)
description: The canonical task-enqueue payload a surface (personal-life-os / pocket-agent / fleet-terminal / desktop) POSTs to agent-fabric's POST /cortex/enqueue (Suite Link §4.1). This is the single stable intake URL for surfaces. agent-fabric validates this shape, builds a conforming cortex/contracts TaskEnvelope from it (minting the id), returns a dispatch_id immediately, and runs the task in-process on the dynamic workflow engine (runWorkflow / runComplexWorkflowAsync; per ADR-0023 the engine supersedes the n8n spine). Per ADR-0014 the shape is authored once here and imported by every consumer; agent-fabric NEVER redefines it. Status: DRAFT v0; v0->v1 gated on a real end-to-end round-trip through the in-process engine (enqueue -> engine -> receipt). Bump $id on breaking changes.

source.description: Originating surface. Lifts the TaskEnvelope.source / WorkRequestSource enum verbatim; NOT redefined. Clarifications route back here and it scopes the Mnemos container.

description.description: Full instruction for the executing agent. Becomes TaskEnvelope.prompt; the spine's cortex.refine.punchup may rewrite it into refined_prompt.

project.description: Coarse routing label. Lifts the TaskEnvelope.project enum verbatim; maps to a Mnemos container root and is carried through decomposition.

tier.description: Complexity tier. Drives whether the enqueue starts a single dispatch or a multi-step dynamic workflow ('complex' => engine), and seeds the model router's tier. Mirrors RouteDecision.tier / TaskEnvelope.complexity.

assigned_agent.description: Optional explicit executor override. Lifts the TaskEnvelope.assigned_agent enum verbatim. null => the spine/Maestro routes.

priority.description: Business priority for queue ordering. Lifts the WorkRequestPriority enum verbatim.

due_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC deadline. Advisory; the spine may use it for queue ordering / escalation.

context_url.description: Optional pointer to source context (mnemos://, repo://, file://, https://). Becomes a TaskEnvelope.context_refs entry.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key, stable across retries. When set, agent-fabric SHOULD dedupe; when null the server mints the TaskEnvelope.id and dispatch_id fresh.

judge_alias.description: Optional intent-punchup judge model alias. Controls only the classifier/synthesizer judge seat; lane execution remains routed by Maestro. Surfaces auto mode resolves live availability before POSTing a concrete alias.
